test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: When do dust storms and thunderstorms generally occur?
solution:
The solution is** In the pre-monsoon period. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dust storms and thunderstorms generally occur **i**n the pre-monsoon period. 
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dust storms and thunderstorms generally occur In the pre-monsoon period i.e. **between March 1 and May 31.**
